instruction: Please add a layer to the image and give it the name 'Star'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new layer named 'Star' in GIMP. Evaluator checks the gimprc config file for the 'layer-new-name' setting. Same complexity as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly parses XCF file structure to extract actual layer names from the saved image (lines 41-129 in getters/gimp.py)
Metric correctly checks if the expected layer name 'Star' exists in the extracted list of layer names
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) before verification, ensuring the XCF file contains the latest changes
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric accesses 'expected_state.get('layer_name')' directly (not 'expected_state.get('rules')'), which is the proper way when expected.type='rule'
Complete instruction coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement (layer named 'Star' exists)
Robust error handling: both getter and metric handle edge cases (missing files, invalid format, parsing errors)
XCF parsing implementation is sound: follows XCF format specification to read header, properties, layer offsets, and layer names
